fault: Access port Fa0/5 on switch SW1 is incorrectly configured in VLAN 10 (Sales) instead of VLAN 20 (Engineering). Consequently, PC-ENG1 is placed in the wrong broadcast domain and receives an IP address in the 10.10.10.0/24 subnet via DHCP/static configuration while its default gateway is set to 10.10.20.1 (VLAN 20), making the gateway and network unreachable.
fix:
On SW1, change the access VLAN for port Fa0/5 to VLAN 20 by executing:
interface fa0/5
 switchport access vlan 20
Then verify connectivity from PC-ENG1 to its default gateway 10.10.20.1.
reasoning: The pre-analysis and show commands confirm that interface Fa0/5 is assigned to VLAN 10 while the host configuration and topology dictate it belongs to VLAN 20. This Layer 2 misconfiguration causes an IP subnet mismatch where the host IP (10.10.10.45) cannot reach its gateway (10.10.20.1).
